sn10.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Indakūṭe pabbate Indakassa yakkhassa bhavane || || Atha kho Indako yakkho yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn10.1:2.1: Rūpaṃ na jīvan ti vadanti buddhā || kathaṃ nvayaṃ vindat-imaṃ sarīraṃ || kut-assa aṭṭhīyakapiṇḍam eti || kathaṃ nvayaṃ sajjati gabbharasmin ti || ||
sn10.1:3.1: Pathamaṃ kalalaṃ hoti || kalalā hoti abbudaṃ || abbudā jāyate pesī || pesī nibbattati ghano || ghanā pasākhā jāyanti || kesā lomā nakhāni ca || ||
sn10.1:4.1: yañ c-assa bhuñjati māta || annam pānañ ca bhojanaṃ || tena so tattha yāpeti || mātukucchigato naro ti || ||
